name: polite_formula
description: Choose the conventional courtesy word please, thanks, or sorry for requests, gratitude, or apology; matched control copies the addressee.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
groups={'please':['politely asking for a glass of water','politely requesting a seat','politely asking for help','politely asking to borrow a pen','politely requesting directions','politely asking someone to open a window','politely requesting silence','politely asking for a menu'], 'thanks':['expressing gratitude for a gift','expressing gratitude for some help','expressing gratitude for a kind message','expressing gratitude for a meal','expressing gratitude for a ride','expressing gratitude for good advice','expressing gratitude for an invitation','expressing gratitude for a compliment'], 'sorry':['apologizing for being late','apologizing for breaking a cup','apologizing for forgetting a meeting','apologizing for making a mistake','apologizing for spilling a drink','apologizing for interrupting','apologizing for losing a book','apologizing for bumping into someone']}
names=['Alice','Bob','Carol','David','Emma','Frank','Grace','Henry']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 answer=list(groups)[i%3]; scene=random.choice(groups[answer]); name=random.choice(names)
 s=f'You are speaking to {name} and {scene}.'
 items.append({'prompt':s+'\nChoose the appropriate courtesy word: please, thanks, or sorry.\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+answer})
 control.append({'prompt':s+'\nWho are you speaking to? Give only the name.\nAnswer:', 'answer':' '+name})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
